tw-wi-hurley-iron-exchange-bank-loot-188.st: The bookkeeper went to Waupun in August 1890 on a five-year term, was dying of consumption by late 1893 when a pardon petition went to the governor, and was released on 15 April 1894; his stepfather was fined $200 with county jail time in January 1891. Neither man is reported to have told where the money went.
src: Milwaukee Daily News, 7 Mar 1894 (release set for 15 Apr 1894)
